# Skills by audience

Find your group: [patients and families](#patients-and-families), [care teams](#care-teams), [researchers](#researchers) or [builders](#builders).

A skill with a "Use it now" link needs no install. Open the link and copy the short box. Then paste it into a new chat. [Where to paste](paste-ready.md) shows how in common AI apps.

These skills give general information, not medical advice. Questions about your own care belong with your care team.

Level: **base** works in a plain chat. **advanced** needs a tool, a script or extra care.

## For builders: install a skill in your agent

A skill can also be installed in an AI agent such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or Cursor. Install it the way [install.md](install.md) describes for your agent, or paste a prompt from [prompts.md](prompts.md). A skill marked (install route only) has no copy-and-paste version yet.

Read a skill's `SKILL.md` and its scripts before you let an agent run them. Research, not medical advice.
